w2:textbox.label:
1. Select a date from the first Date column and confirm that the onDateSelect event fires.
2. Select a month from the second Month column and confirm that the onMonthSelect event fires.
3. Select a year from the third Year column and confirm that the onYearSelect event fires.
(Detailed scripts for each event handler can be found in the Script tab.)

Event Description

ondateselect - Fired when a date is selected.
onmonthselect - Fired when a month is selected.
onyearselect - Fired when a year is selected.

/// Sample Code

scwin.gridView1_ondateselect = function (row, col, dateStr, dateObj) {
   var toshow = JSON.stringify(dateObj);
   alert("ondateselect - Row : " + row + " Column : " + col + " Date String : " + dateStr + " Date Object : " + toshow);
};

scwin.gridView1_onmonthselect = function (row, col, info) {
   var toshow = JSON.stringify(info);
   alert("onmonthselect - Row : " + row + " Column : " + col + " Info : " + toshow);

};

scwin.gridView1_onyearselect = function (row, col, info) {
   var toshow = JSON.stringify(info);
   alert("onmonthselect - Row : " + row + " Column : " + col + " Info : " + toshow);
};
